title: gg Ecosystem: 4-Repo Unified Workflow
desc: Unified gg-ecosystem principle: Periodic execution detects risks → immediate safety measures → autonomous problem resolution. 4-repo workflows (WKAppBot suggest triage, personal-docs legal ops, wkappbot-sdk QA health, WkAutoQuant market mgmt) with CronCreate automation per repo, Step Count Contract enforcement, harness:skill validation, and auto-healing anomaly detection every 3 hours.
steps: PURPOSE: 4-repo unified gg. Periodic execution detects risks -> immediate safety -> autonomous resolution. Repos: WKAppBot (suggest triage), personal-docs (legal/career), wkappbot-sdk (QA health), WkAutoQuant (market). next:gg-ecosystem-unified-ref for per-repo script paths + CronCreate schedules.

AUTOMATION: CronCreate per repo in CLAUDE.md Nightly Schedules. nightly-schedule-guard validates all entries at session start. STEP COUNT CONTRACT: each script STEPS list must match CLAUDE.md workflow count. Mismatch = speak alert + exit 1.

ANOMALY DETECTION: novel errors in errors.jsonl OR novel suggest patterns -> BUG-AUTO file + Opus escalation when urgent>=10 or error-pattern>=15. ZERO APPROVAL DELAY. Script self-learning via .anomalies.jsonl.
HARNESS:SKILL: each script declares 3 required skill reads (Usage/Impl/Task). Registered in each repo CLAUDE.md near workflow definition. Codex delegates multi-repo fixes (1 commit per repo).
